person.name: Sam Rivera
person.headline: I design money apps people finish setting up. **Eight years** in fintech, the last three leading the savings products at Ledger Bank.
person.proof: Ledger Bank, Northwind, Kite. Set-up completion up from **41% to 63%** on my last launch.

authorship: Every project says what my part was. Where a team was involved, it is named.
ask: Hiring for a product team that ships? Write to me.

projects.title: Ledger savings flow
projects.summary: Redesign of the savings set-up in a banking app: from nine screens to four.
projects.result: Set-up completion went from 41% to 63% in the first month after launch.

rows.note: People dropped out when asked for a savings goal. I moved the goal to after the first deposit, because the first deposit was the moment they cared.

projects.decision: People dropped out when asked for a savings goal. I moved the goal to after the first deposit, because the first deposit was the moment they cared.

projects.title: Northwind design system
projects.summary: One set of components for three products that had grown apart.
projects.result: Adopted by all three product teams; new screens ship from existing components in days, not weeks.

rows.note: We kept two button styles instead of five: every extra variant had doubled the review time for new screens.

projects.decision: We kept two button styles instead of five: every extra variant had doubled the review time for new screens.

projects.title: Kiosk check-in
projects.summary: A self check-in for small clinics, designed and tested as a personal project.
projects.result: Tested with 8 people in one clinic; all checked in without help.

rows.note: I dropped the touchscreen keyboard for a QR hand-off to the patient's phone after watching five people struggle with it.

projects.decision: I dropped the touchscreen keyboard for a QR hand-off to the patient's phone after watching five people struggle with it.
